definitions.explanation: the period of heavy traffic congestion when people return home from work, typically in the evening

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュで{電車|でんしゃ}が{混|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: The train was crowded due to the evening rush.

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュを{避|さ}けて{遅|おそ}く{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I went home late to avoid the evening rush.

examples.japanese: {金曜|きんよう}の{帰宅|きたく}ラッシュは{特|とく}にひどい。
examples.english: The Friday evening rush is especially bad.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{帰宅|きたく} (returning home) + ラッシュ (rush, from English)

TIMING:
Typically refers to:
- 5:30-8:00 PM in major Japanese cities
- Often less concentrated than morning rush

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ (evening rush) ↔ {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ (morning rush)

RELATED WORDS:
- {満員電車|まんいんでんしゃ} - packed train
- {終電|しゅうでん} - last train
- {残業|ざんぎょう} - overtime work
- {飲|の}み{会|かい} - drinking party (common reason to avoid evening rush)
